## Personality

Stacy is a bright and sympathetic young woman. She possesses a natural gift for winning and keeping the affections of her pupils, effectively bringing out their moral and mental best.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## History

Miss Stacy became the new schoolteacher in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where she quickly earned the affection of her students, including [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). She introduced engaging educational activities, such as organizing a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert to raise funds for a school flag and later announcing plans to prepare her students for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exam. After taking the students through their studies, she successfully helped guide pupils like [Anne](../character/anne.md) to write and pass their crucial examinations.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P2](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. ## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--stacy.md)

Miss Stacy serves as a mentor and close teacher to [Anne](../character/anne.md), advising her on advanced academic work as she prepares for the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations. Under Miss Stacy's guidance, [Anne](../character/anne.md) blossoms into a mature, disciplined student, taking part in school projects like the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert flag fundraiser and eventually tying for first place on the [Island](../codex/places.md#island). Beyond her educational duties, Miss Stacy acts as a supportive friend who actively encourages Anne's growth and academic ambitions.

- Friend of — good friend who encourages her to grow up right  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008)</sub>
- Mentor of — teacher advising Anne on taking Second Year work  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stacy.md)

Miss Stacy becomes the new teacher at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school while [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) is recovering from a broken ankle, and [Anne](../character/anne.md) eagerly anticipates her arrival. Upon taking charge of the classroom, Miss Stacy acts as a true and helpful friend, guiding [Anne](../character/anne.md) through academic challenges and reassuring her students that she will prepare them for future examinations. Her encouraging leadership inspires [Anne](../character/anne.md) to focus on personal growth, helping her navigate school life and embarrassing misadventures.

- Friend of — teacher and true and helpful friend  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
